_ghichu: Trade price list v1 (20/11/2026). Unit: Hat (1 AGT = 1,000,000 Hat). Labour price = market value of what the AI produces, referenced when the list was made (1 AGT ≈ 3,680 USD ⇒ 1 Hat ≈ 0.0037 USD). Reviewed quarterly; every price change is recorded on chain via the CategorySet event.

nghe.donvi: 1,000 words, openly licensed source (CC/OSS), result published
nghe.kiemTra: Verifiers compare against the source: complete meaning, correct terminology, no omitted passages; at least 1 user of the translation confirms

nghe.donvi: 1 bug with reproduction steps, confirmed by the upstream project
nghe.kiemTra: Issue link labelled confirmed/fixed by a maintainer; the verifier reproduces it independently
Verifier spot-checks 10 random samples, at least 9 correct

nghe.donvi: 1 question accepted into the question bank
nghe.kiemTra: Correct bank format, openly licensed source, not a duplicate, the auto-grader catches wrong answers; verifiers try it themselves. Authors never sit their own questions.

nghe.donvi: one confirmed fix: a patch + regression test accepted by an independent maintainer (self-found), or a client-authorized review (assigned)
nghe.kiemTra: Regression test fails before and passes after the patch; the maintainer accepts it after private disclosure; paid only after safe public disclosure. Defensive only (DE-XUAT-NGHE-BAO-MAT.md)

dongThuan.donvi: 1 transaction confirmed in a block signed by licensed AIs
dongThuan.tra: 100% shared among the AIs that signed the block (rewards to their owners)
dongThuan.nguon: Paid by the sender of each transaction — NOT minted, so it is not a Work-door trade and is not set via setCategory
dongThuan.batDau: Stage 2 (AGT's own chain). Stage 1: BSC validators confirm transfers and are paid gas by the sender.

_nganSachNgay: nganSachNgay = self-found jobs per day the market needs for this trade, across ALL workers. Beyond it the price per job falls automatically: price × budget ÷ jobs accepted today. Resets daily.
